'''Satomi Koorogi''' (Japanese: '''こおろぎさとみ''' ''Koorogi Satomi'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Koorogi was born as '''Satomi Kourogi''' (Japanese: '''興梠さとみ''' ''Kourogi Satomi)'' on November 14, 1962, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She voiced many people and Pokémon throughout {{aniseries|PTS}}. One of her most notable roles in that work was [[Misty's Togetic]]. Koorogi is currently affiliated with Production Baobab. She is bilingual, being capable of speaking both Japanese and English.
